title: Fixed citation marker leakage found by LLM judge audit
points: Ran a DeepSeek judge over 50 recent successful production answers to catch hidden answer-quality issues.
Fixed sanitizer handling for italicized USED_SOURCE_TAGS and USED_TABLE_TAGS lines so internal citation markers do not leak to users.
Removed model-emitted duplicate disclaimers before appending the standard psxGPT disclaimer.
